notes.title: VR Party Pack V2.1
notes.content:
Let me set the scene: I’m sent home from university because of the stupid virus thing and sitting at my computer. I’m thumbing through all my assignments as I think to myself, “What to do… what to do...” A moment of clarity strikes: “Make an update to VR Party Pack OF COURSE!” And that’s just what I did. Enjoy. With love,[url=www.westonbdev.com] Weston Bell-Geddes[/url].ːghsmileː

[h2]OVERALL[/h2]
[list]
[*] Slight graphics improvements
[*] Non-HTC Vive users were having trouble getting back to the main menu, so I added a button input on the controller to help with that
[*] Re-wrote the backend framework to add rapid scalability for mini-games and bug fix fixes
[/list]

[h2]FIXED[/h2]
[b]Basketball[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a little AI aim assist to help you make totally radical free throws
[/list]
[b]Beer Pong[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug that caused the counter to go up forever
[/list]
[b]Bowling[/b]
[list]
[*] Bug caused ball to bounce if the rotational linear force of the ball was greater than the directional velocity of the ball towards the pins
[/list]
[b]Box Artist[/b]
[list]
[*] Bug caused camera to not detach from player’s HMD
[*] Players can no longer escape the recording area
[/list]
[b]Dartsmith[/b]
[list]
[*] Darts didn’t stick if angle of friction between dart and board was greater than 35 degrees. So I added a semi-angle of the point of the grooving tool (dart) so that the board accepts darts that are fired at an angle
[/list]
[b]Home Run Derby[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed player’s hands to baseball bats -- much better
[*] Made ocean prettier
[/list]
[b]Party Ninja[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a stronger “normal force” (‘horizontal’ force parallel to cutting blade) when slicing objects to make it more obvious when an object has been successful sliced
[/list]
[b]Ping Pong[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to switch hands without switching controllers in real life
[/list]

I know what you’re thinking, “Alright that’s great and all… but what do I have to look forward to?” Well… do I have an answer for you!
[list]
[*] Currently talking with a music studio about making an OST for VR Party Pack!
[*] Looking in to adding some voice acting in some minigames
[*] SO MANY MORE MINIGAMES! And of course polishing the already published ones!
[/list]

As always, if you have any questions, concerns, comments or SUGGESTIONS please feel free to reach out. Let me know what you want to see next!

notes.title: VR Party Pack V2.0
notes.content:
Thanks to those who gave feedback. I am extremely passionate about VR Party Pack and will be dedicating a lot of time to it. So I present to you… VR PARTY PACK VERSION 2: PARTY-ER and PACKY-ER than ever before!! We got new games (WOW) and I fixed [b]SO MANY BUGS[/b]! Please enjoy. As always, if you have any questions, concerns or comments please feel free to [url=mailto:westonbdev@gmail.com]reach out[/url]. With love, [url=https://www.westonbdev.com/]Weston Bell-Geddes[/url]. ːghsmileː

[h3]OVERALL[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added hand grip animations
[*] Slight layout adjustment to game select room
[*] Various adjustments to physics engines to give objects a more realistic bounce
[*] Added a prototype height adjustment mechanic to some minigames
[*] Does some SICC MATH and makes adjustments to the height of some game objects
[/list]
[h3]FIXED[/h3]
[list]
[b]Bowling[/b]
[*] Overhauled physics engines to decrease lag
[b]Crazy Climber[/b]
[*] Added minigame mechanic: fastest time to the top wins!
[*] Added mountains
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35633048/719836646e4dcd034162734a185b3884a8703a13.png[/img]
[b]Party Ninja[/b]
[*] Made objects slice more easily
[*] Moved object spawners closer to player’s center of playspace
[/list]
[h3]ADDED[/h3]
[list]
[b]Box Artist[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35633048/4067df6e33ba91d7d61463610f0fbd72e2e581a2.png[/img]
[*] Build words with boxes, destroy your enemies!
[b]Dartsmith[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35633048/bc2c290b41fd7d0e3fe0a7106454c8e96972f2b0.png[/img]
[*] Good ol’ darts (but the year is 2069)!
[b]Home Run Derby[/b]
[*] Try to hit a baseball as far as you can into the FREAKIN’ OCEAN!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35633048/f81051e65e1f9d17515c70e59df48d5748335d62.png[/img]
[/list]
Check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1010840/VR_Party_Pack/]new trailer[/url] for some footage!
